   # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   # Gate 2b: Test aggregate — required gate that all shards passed
+  #
+  # v1.00.29 W9 rework (dup-01 removal, review round 1): this job is
+  # green only when every fast shard AND the platform checks passed, so
+  # it is the single producer of the fast-suite proof bundle. The
+  # scheduled nightly test job may then REUSE this proof at the same SHA
+  # (same selection, same ubuntu-latest/racket-8.10 environment, same
+  # strictness — W0 exact_duplicate dup-01) instead of re-executing the
+  # identical suite. The bundle is evidence, not a cached exit code: the
+  # consumer re-validates it fail-closed (validator steps 1-15) and runs
+  # the suite on ANY consume failure — never a silent skip (§11.3).
   # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   test-aggregate:
     needs: [test, test-platform]
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - run: echo "All test shards and platform checks passed."
 
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-racket
+        with:
+          racket-version: ${{ github.event.inputs.racket-version || '8.10' }}
+
+      # The fast shards upload their run-summary JSON as
+      # test-results-fast-<shard> (one file per artifact, so no
+      # merge-multiple: artifacts land in per-artifact subdirectories).
+      - name: Download fast-suite shard results
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
+        with:
+          path: shard-results
+          pattern: test-results-fast-*
+
+      # Produces the q.proof-bundle/1 for claim:pr-ci:linux-fast-suite
+      # from the per-shard results. N2 (review round 1): the claim's
+      # tests_failed/tests_skipped are the REAL aggregated counts; the
+      # step FAILS unless every shard reported and the aggregate is clean
+      # (zero failures, timeouts and skips), so a bundle over a non-clean
+      # aggregate can never exist. Digests are computed over named real
+      # inputs; each recipe is recorded in the claim JSON's digest_sources
+      # map (annotations only — consume.rkt ignores unknown keys, the
+      # validator's closed shapes are untouched). This step only runs on a
+      # green aggregate (needs: [test, test-platform] with no always()),
+      # so a failed or cancelled shard can never yield a reusable bundle.
+      - name: Produce fast-suite proof bundle
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p artifacts-run proof-bundle
+          SHARD_JSONS="$(find shard-results -name test-results.json | LC_ALL=C sort)"
+          if [ -z "$SHARD_JSONS" ]; then
+            echo "producer: no shard results downloaded (refusing to write a bundle)" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          : > artifacts-run/shards.jsonl
+          for f in $SHARD_JSONS; do
+            jq -c --arg artifact "$(basename "$(dirname "$f")")" \
+              '{artifact: $artifact,
+                shard: .run_summary.shard,
+                file_count: .run_summary.file_count,
+                pass: .run_summary.pass,
+                fail: .run_summary.fail,
+                timeout: .run_summary.timeout,
+                skip: .run_summary.skip,
+                wall_clock_seconds: .run_summary.wall_clock_seconds}' "$f" >> artifacts-run/shards.jsonl
+          done
+          jq -s '{
+            suite: "fast",
+            sharded: true,
+            shards: (sort_by(.artifact)),
+            file_count: (map(.file_count) | add),
+            pass: (map(.pass) | add),
+            fail: (map(.fail) | add),
+            timeout: (map(.timeout) | add),
+            skip: (map(.skip) | add),
+            wall_clock_seconds: (map(.wall_clock_seconds) | max),
+            elapsed_ms_basis: "max shard wall_clock_seconds; shards execute in parallel so the suite completed when the slowest shard completed"
+          }' artifacts-run/shards.jsonl > artifacts-run/fast-suite-results-summary.json
+          SUMMARY="artifacts-run/fast-suite-results-summary.json"
+          FILE_TOTAL="$(jq '.file_count' "$SUMMARY")"
+          PASS_TOTAL="$(jq '.pass' "$SUMMARY")"
+          FAIL_TOTAL="$(jq '.fail' "$SUMMARY")"
+          TIMEOUT_TOTAL="$(jq '.timeout' "$SUMMARY")"
+          SKIP_TOTAL="$(jq '.skip' "$SUMMARY")"
+          if [ "$FILE_TOTAL" -eq 0 ] || [ "$FAIL_TOTAL" -ne 0 ] || [ "$TIMEOUT_TOTAL" -ne 0 ] || [ "$SKIP_TOTAL" -ne 0 ]; then
+            echo "producer: refusing to write a proof bundle over a non-clean aggregate (files=$FILE_TOTAL fail=$FAIL_TOTAL timeout=$TIMEOUT_TOTAL skip=$SKIP_TOTAL)" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "producer: clean fast-suite aggregate (files=$FILE_TOTAL pass=$PASS_TOTAL fail=$FAIL_TOTAL timeout=$TIMEOUT_TOTAL skip=$SKIP_TOTAL)"
+          WF_REVISION="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA":.github/workflows/ci.yml)"
+          TREE_SHA="$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
+          CREATED_AT="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+          COMPLETED_AT="$CREATED_AT"
+          RESULT_SHA="sha256:$(sha256sum "$SUMMARY" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          RESULT_SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$SUMMARY")"
+          ELAPSED_MS="$(jq '(.wall_clock_seconds * 1000) | floor' "$SUMMARY")"
+          START_EPOCH="$(( $(date -u +%s) - ( (ELAPSED_MS + 999) / 1000 ) ))"
+          STARTED_AT="$(date -u -d "@${START_EPOCH}" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
+          INVENTORY_SHA="sha256:$(git ls-files tests | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          racket scripts/run-tests/classify-metadata.rkt --metadata-inventory-json > artifacts-run/metadata-inventory.json
+          METADATA_SHA="sha256:$(sha256sum artifacts-run/metadata-inventory.json | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          COVERS_SHA="sha256:$(git grep -h '@covers' -- tests | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          SELECTED_SHA="sha256:$(jq -s '[.[].files[].path] | unique | .[]' $SHARD_JSONS | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          RUNNER_REV="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA":scripts/run-tests.rkt)"
+          FLAGS_SHA="sha256:$(printf '%s' '--suite fast --jobs 4 --shard-index <shard> --shard-total <total> --json-out test-results.json' | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          LOCK_SHA="sha256:$(sha256sum ci/racket-package-lock.rktd | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          RACKET_BIN="$(readlink -f "$(command -v racket)")"
+          RACKET_EXEC_SHA="sha256:$(sha256sum "$RACKET_BIN" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          RECIPE_SHA="sha256:$(sha256sum .github/actions/setup-racket/action.yml | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          PKGSET_SHA="sha256:$( { raco pkg ls 2>/dev/null || echo pkg-ls-unavailable; } | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          FEATFLAGS_SHA="sha256:$(printf '%s' '1' | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          RELENV_SHA="sha256:$(cat /etc/os-release | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          CHECKOUT_SHA="sha256:$(git ls-files | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          COMPILED_SHA="sha256:$(find . -name '*.zo' -type f -not -path './tests/metadata-discovery/fixture/*' -printf '%p %s\n' 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+          cat > artifacts-run/claim.json <<'JSON_EOF'
+          {
+            "created_at": "@@CREATED_AT@@",
+            "workflow_path": ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
+            "environment_class": "linux-racket-8.10-fast",
+            "attestation_digest": "@@CHECKOUT_SHA@@",
+            "allowed_consumers": ["workflow:nightly.yml:test"],
+            "denied_consumers": [],
+            "release_reusable": false,
+            "producer": {
+              "run_id": "@@RUN_ID@@",
+              "run_attempt": @@RUN_ATTEMPT@@,
+              "job_id": "@@JOB_ID@@",
+              "job_name": "test-aggregate",
+              "event": "@@EVENT@@",
+              "ref": "@@REF@@",
+              "trust_tier": "tier-1"
+            },
+            "claims": [
+              {
+                "claim_id": "claim:pr-ci:linux-fast-suite",
+                "claim_version": 1,
+                "proof_class": "fast",
+                "required_environment_class": "linux-racket-8.10-fast",
+                "gate_class": "required",
+                "result": "pass"
+              }
+            ],
+            "selection": {
+              "inventory_digest": "@@INVENTORY_SHA@@",
+              "metadata_manifest_digest": "@@METADATA_SHA@@",
+              "covers_manifest_digest": "@@COVERS_SHA@@",
+              "selected_manifest_digest": "@@SELECTED_SHA@@",
+              "selected_count": @@FILE_TOTAL@@,
+              "selection_mode": "suite:fast",
+              "selector_revision_sha": "@@RUNNER_REV@@",
+              "explanation_artifact_digest": "@@RESULT_SHA@@"
+            },
+            "command": {
+              "argv": ["racket", "scripts/run-tests.rkt", "--suite", "fast", "--jobs", "4", "--shard-index", "<shard>", "--shard-total", "<total>", "--json-out", "test-results.json"],
+              "cwd_contract": "repo-root",
+              "flags_digest": "@@FLAGS_SHA@@",
+              "runner_revision_sha": "@@RUNNER_REV@@"
+            },
+            "environment": {
+              "os": "linux",
+              "os_version": "24.04",
+              "runner_image": "ubuntu-24.04",
+              "architecture": "x86_64",
+              "racket_version": "8.10",
+              "racket_executable_digest": "@@RACKET_EXEC_SHA@@",
+              "racket_installer_digest": "@@RECIPE_SHA@@",
+              "package_lock_digest": "@@LOCK_SHA@@",
+              "resolved_package_set_digest": "@@PKGSET_SHA@@",
+              "locale": "C.UTF-8",
+              "timezone": "UTC"
+            },
+            "policy": {
+              "test_profile": "fast",
+              "security_profile": "strict",
+              "sandbox_profile": "none",
+              "feature_flags_digest": "@@FEATFLAGS_SHA@@",
+              "relevant_environment_digest": "@@RELENV_SHA@@"
+            },
+            "prepared_environment": {
+              "mode": "cold",
+              "artifact_digest": "@@CHECKOUT_SHA@@",
+              "build_recipe_digest": "@@RECIPE_SHA@@",
+              "verification_status": "verified",
+              "compiled_cache_digest": "@@COMPILED_SHA@@"
+            },
+            "result": {
+              "status": "pass",
+              "started_at": "@@STARTED_AT@@",
+              "completed_at": "@@COMPLETED_AT@@",
+              "elapsed_ms": @@ELAPSED_MS@@,
+              "tests_passed": @@PASS_TOTAL@@,
+              "tests_failed": @@FAIL_TOTAL@@,
+              "tests_skipped": @@SKIP_TOTAL@@,
+              "allowed_skip_reasons": [],
+              "timeouts": @@TIMEOUT_TOTAL@@,
+              "cancelled": false,
+              "retry_count": 0,
+              "result_summary_digest": "@@RESULT_SHA@@"
+            },
+            "artifacts": [
+              {
+                "name": "fast-suite-results-summary",
+                "media_type": "application/json",
+                "digest": "@@RESULT_SHA@@",
+                "size_bytes": @@RESULT_SIZE@@,
+                "store": "evidence-store",
+                "store_object_id": "fast-suite-results-summary@@RUN_ID@@"
+              }
+            ],
+            "digest_sources": {
+              "note": "annotations for auditors; consume.rkt write ignores unknown claim-document keys",
+              "inventory_digest": "sha256 over `git ls-files tests | sort`",
+              "metadata_manifest_digest": "sha256 over scripts/run-tests/classify-metadata.rkt --metadata-inventory-json",
+              "covers_manifest_digest": "sha256 over sorted `git grep -h '@covers' -- tests` lines",
+              "selected_manifest_digest": "sha256 over the executed selection: sorted union of .files[].path across all shard test-results.json",
+              "runner_revision_sha": "blob sha of scripts/run-tests.rkt at GITHUB_SHA",
+              "racket_executable_digest": "sha256 of the resolved racket executable bytes",
+              "racket_installer_digest": "sha256 of .github/actions/setup-racket/action.yml (the pinned provisioning recipe)",
+              "package_lock_digest": "sha256 of ci/racket-package-lock.rktd",
+              "resolved_package_set_digest": "sha256 over sorted `raco pkg ls` output",
+              "feature_flags_digest": "sha256 over the literal '1' — every shard executes with STRICT_TEST_RUNNER=1 (the runner's strict zero-test detection is also on by default)",
+              "relevant_environment_digest": "sha256 over sorted /etc/os-release content",
+              "flags_digest": "sha256 over the common per-shard argv template; only the <shard>/<total> placeholders vary per shard",
+              "prepared_environment.mode": "cold: the workspace was purged (W4) and rebuilt from THIS checkout by the shards' compile gates + suite; when the W3 prepared-environment restore was active it restored a manifest-verified identity-equivalent tuple (W6), so the cold annotation stays the conservative honest baseline",
+              "compiled_cache_digest": "sha256 over sorted '*.zo' path+size lines (fixture dir excluded)",
+              "attestation_digest": "sha256 over `git ls-files | sort` (checkout manifest attestation)",
+              "result_summary_digest": "sha256 of artifacts-run/fast-suite-results-summary.json (the aggregated per-shard counts uploaded as fast-suite-results-summary)"
+            }
+          }
+          JSON_EOF
+          sed -i \
+            -e "s|@@CREATED_AT@@|${CREATED_AT}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@CHECKOUT_SHA@@|${CHECKOUT_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RUN_ID@@|${GITHUB_RUN_ID}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RUN_ATTEMPT@@|${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@JOB_ID@@|${GITHUB_JOB}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@EVENT@@|${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@REF@@|${GITHUB_REF}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@INVENTORY_SHA@@|${INVENTORY_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@METADATA_SHA@@|${METADATA_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@COVERS_SHA@@|${COVERS_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@SELECTED_SHA@@|${SELECTED_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@FILE_TOTAL@@|${FILE_TOTAL}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@PASS_TOTAL@@|${PASS_TOTAL}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@FAIL_TOTAL@@|${FAIL_TOTAL}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@TIMEOUT_TOTAL@@|${TIMEOUT_TOTAL}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@SKIP_TOTAL@@|${SKIP_TOTAL}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RUNNER_REV@@|${RUNNER_REV}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RESULT_SHA@@|${RESULT_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RESULT_SIZE@@|${RESULT_SIZE}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@FLAGS_SHA@@|${FLAGS_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RACKET_EXEC_SHA@@|${RACKET_EXEC_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RECIPE_SHA@@|${RECIPE_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@LOCK_SHA@@|${LOCK_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@PKGSET_SHA@@|${PKGSET_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@FEATFLAGS_SHA@@|${FEATFLAGS_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@RELENV_SHA@@|${RELENV_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@COMPILED_SHA@@|${COMPILED_SHA}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@STARTED_AT@@|${STARTED_AT}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@COMPLETED_AT@@|${COMPLETED_AT}|g" \
+            -e "s|@@ELAPSED_MS@@|${ELAPSED_MS}|g" \
+            artifacts-run/claim.json
+          racket scripts/proof-bundle/consume.rkt write \
+            --claims-json artifacts-run/claim.json \
+            --producer-identity "ci.yml:test-aggregate" \
+            --workflow-revision-sha "$WF_REVISION" \
+            --commit-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
+            --tree-sha "$TREE_SHA" \
+            --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+            --retention-days 14 \
+            --out proof-bundle/bundle.json
+          cp artifacts-run/claim.json proof-bundle/claim.json
+          echo "proof bundle: $(jq -r '.bundle_id' proof-bundle/bundle.json)"
+
+      - name: Upload proof bundle (fast)
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
+        with:
+          name: proof-bundle-fast
+          path: |
+            proof-bundle/bundle.json
+            proof-bundle/claim.json
+          if-no-files-found: ignore
+          retention-days: 14
+

@@ -5,6 +5,13 @@ on:
     - cron: '0 3 * * *'
   workflow_dispatch:
 
+# v1.00.29 W9 rework (dup-01 reuse; review round 1 finding B3): consuming
+# another workflow's proof bundle requires the Actions read scope — the
+# consume step runs `gh run list` / `gh run download` against ci.yml runs.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  actions: read
+
 jobs:
   test:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
@@ -17,8 +24,182 @@ jobs:
       # the suite executes. Pinned by tests/test-workflow-purge-contract.rkt.
       - name: Install Racket
         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-racket
+
+      # v1.00.29 W9 rework (dup-01 removal): reuse the fast-suite proof the
+      # ci.yml#test-aggregate job produced for THIS commit instead of
+      # re-executing the identical suite (same selection, same
+      # ubuntu-latest/racket-8.10 environment, same strictness — W0
+      # exact_duplicate dup-01). The bundle is evidence, never a cached exit
+      # code: it is re-validated fail-closed (validator steps 1-15) by
+      # scripts/proof-bundle/consume.rkt; ANY failure — no matching ci run,
+      # missing artifact, tampered bundle, stale commit, expired retention,
+      # unauthorized consumer, wrong claim, environment mismatch — sets
+      # bundle_ok=false and the suite below RUNS. Fallback causes are
+      # recorded per run (§11.3 no-silent-fallback); the decision artifact
+      # is always uploaded. Exit contract: 0 = reusable (only then may the
+      # suite be skipped), 3 = not-reusable, 4 = invalid/unreadable.
+      #
+      # The step itself never fails the job (fail-safe): every hiccup
+      # records the fallback and leaves bundle_ok=false, so the worst case
+      # is exactly the pre-W9 behavior — the suite runs.
+      - name: Resolve + consume fast-suite proof bundle
+        id: consume
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p proof-bundle-decision
+          DECISION="proof-bundle-decision/reuse-decision.json"
+          CONSUMER_ID="workflow:nightly.yml:test"
+          REQUIRED_CLAIM="claim:pr-ci:linux-fast-suite"
+          PRODUCER_ID="ci.yml:test-aggregate"
+          # Fail-closed default: a decision record exists for EVERY run; a
+          # path that cannot reach the validator keeps this one.
+          printf '{"schema":"q.reuse-decision/1","decision":"not-reusable","reason":"consume-not-run","consumer-id":"%s","zero-tests-run":false,"normal-proof-executed":true}\n' "$CONSUMER_ID" > "$DECISION"
+
+          run_consume() {
+            set -euo pipefail
+            BUNDLE_OK=false
+            RUN_ID=""
+            RUN_ATTEMPT=""
+            # Resolve the latest successful ci.yml run for THIS commit. N4
+            # (review round 1): the expected run attempt is derived from the
+            # API response's runAttempt — never copied from the bundle.
+            if gh run list --workflow ci.yml --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --status success --json databaseId,runAttempt --limit 5 > proof-bundle-decision/candidate-runs.json; then
+              RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.[0].databaseId // empty' proof-bundle-decision/candidate-runs.json)"
+              RUN_ATTEMPT="$(jq -r '.[0].runAttempt // empty' proof-bundle-decision/candidate-runs.json)"
+            else
+              echo "resolve: gh run list unavailable (fallback: run the suite)" | tee proof-bundle-decision/fallback-cause.txt
+            fi
+            if [ -n "$RUN_ID" ] && [ -n "$RUN_ATTEMPT" ] && gh run download "$RUN_ID" -n proof-bundle-fast -D /tmp/pb; then
+              BUNDLE="/tmp/pb/bundle.json"
+              WF_REVISION="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA":.github/workflows/ci.yml)"
+              TREE_SHA="$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
+              NOW="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+              # Review round 1 (dup-01): the environment expectation is
+              # PINNED to THIS lane's real environment — ubuntu-latest +
+              # Racket 8.10 via the setup-racket action — and its own
+              # digest recipes; it is never copied from the bundle. A
+              # producer that did not run on this same environment class
+              # fails validator step 9 here and the suite runs.
+              RACKET_BIN="$(readlink -f "$(command -v racket)")"
+              jq -n \
+                --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+                --arg commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
+                --arg tree "$TREE_SHA" \
+                --arg wfrev "$WF_REVISION" \
+                --arg now "$NOW" \
+                --arg consumer "$CONSUMER_ID" \
+                --arg producer "$PRODUCER_ID" \
+                --arg claim "$REQUIRED_CLAIM" \
+                --arg racket_exec "sha256:$(sha256sum "$RACKET_BIN" | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
+                --arg racket_inst "sha256:$(sha256sum .github/actions/setup-racket/action.yml | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
+                --arg lock "sha256:$(sha256sum ci/racket-package-lock.rktd | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
+                --arg pkgset "sha256:$( { raco pkg ls 2>/dev/null || echo pkg-ls-unavailable; } | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
+                --arg relenv "sha256:$(cat /etc/os-release | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
+                --argjson attempt "$RUN_ATTEMPT" \
+                --slurpfile b "$BUNDLE" \
+                '{
+                  "expected-repository": $repo,
+                  "expected-producer-identity": $producer,
+                  "expected-workflow-revision-sha": $wfrev,
+                  "expected-commit-sha": $commit,
+                  "expected-tree-sha": $tree,
+                  "subject-binding": "commit",
+                  "expected-environment": {
+                    "os": "linux",
+                    "os_version": "24.04",
+                    "runner_image": "ubuntu-24.04",
+                    "architecture": "x86_64",
+                    "racket_version": "8.10",
+                    "racket_executable_digest": $racket_exec,
+                    "racket_installer_digest": $racket_inst,
+                    "package_lock_digest": $lock,
+                    "resolved_package_set_digest": $pkgset,
+                    "locale": "C.UTF-8",
+                    "timezone": "UTC"
+                  },
+                  "expected-security-profile": $b[0].policy.security_profile,
+                  "expected-test-profile": $b[0].policy.test_profile,
+                  "expected-sandbox-profile": $b[0].policy.sandbox_profile,
+                  "expected-feature-flags-digest": $b[0].policy.feature_flags_digest,
+                  "expected-relevant-environment-digest": $relenv,
+                  "expected-selection-digests": {
+                    "inventory_digest": $b[0].selection.inventory_digest,
+                    "metadata_manifest_digest": $b[0].selection.metadata_manifest_digest,
+                    "covers_manifest_digest": $b[0].selection.covers_manifest_digest,
+                    "selected_manifest_digest": $b[0].selection.selected_manifest_digest
+                  },
+                  "expected-artifacts": ($b[0].artifacts | map({key: .name, value: .digest}) | from_entries),
+                  "expected-result-summary-digest": $b[0].result.result_summary_digest,
+                  "expected-prepared-env-artifact-digest": $b[0].prepared_environment.artifact_digest,
+                  "current-time": $now,
+                  "minimum-retention-until": $now,
+                  "consumer-id": $consumer,
+                  "consumer-mode": "regular",
+                  "required-claim-ids": [$claim],
+                  "claim-gate-class": "required",
+                  "expected-run-attempt": $attempt
+                }' > proof-bundle-decision/request.json
+              set +e
+              racket scripts/proof-bundle/consume.rkt consume \
+                --bundle "$BUNDLE" \
+                --request-json proof-bundle-decision/request.json \
+                --out "$DECISION"
+              CONSUME_RC=$?
+              set -e
+              if [ "$CONSUME_RC" -eq 0 ]; then

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; q/scripts/proof-bundle/consume.rkt — v1.00.29 W9: CLI adapter over the
+;; canonical q.proof-bundle/1 writer (bundle-writer.rkt) and the read-only
+;; fail-closed consumer validator (bundle-validator.rkt).
+;;
+;; Two subcommands:
+;;
+;;   write   — assemble a q.proof-bundle/1 from a claim/context JSON document
+;;             plus scalar producer arguments, finalize it (content-addressed
+;;             bundle_id, producer completeness gate §5.2–§5.16) and write the
+;;             canonical single-line JSON to --out. Prints the bundle_id.
+;;   consume — run validate-proof-bundle-file (validator steps 1–15) for a
+;;             bundle + consumer request pair, write the q.reuse-decision/1
+;;             record (§11.3) to --out and exit
+;;                 0  'reusable        (the ONLY exit code that permits skip)
+;;                 3  not-reusable     (authentic but incompatible: fallback)
+;;                 4  invalid          (corrupt/inauthentic: fallback)
+;;             Any other failure (unreadable files, bad usage) also never
+;;             yields 0. NEVER a silent skip: the caller treats every
+;;             non-zero exit as "run the suite".
+;;
+;; The --claims-json document for `write` carries the claim records plus the
+;; producer-side run context (all values that vary per run):
+;;
+;;   { "created_at": "<RFC3339 UTC>",            (required)
+;;     "workflow_path": ".github/workflows/...", (required)
+;;     "producer": { run_id, run_attempt, job_id, job_name, event, ref,
+;;                   trust_tier },               (required, §5.3)
+;;     "claims": [ { claim_id, claim_version, proof_class,
+;;                   required_environment_class, gate_class, result } ],
+;;                                               (required, non-empty, §5.5)
+;;     "selection" | "command" | "environment" | "policy" |
+;;     "prepared_environment" | "result" | "artifacts", (required §5.6–§5.12)
+;;     "environment_class": "...",               (required, §5.16)
+;;     "attestation_digest": "sha256:...",       (required, §5.13)
+;;     "allowed_consumers": ["..."],             (required, §5.15)
+;;     "subject_mode" (default "commit"), "subject_dirty" (default false),
+;;     "denied_consumers" (default []), "release_reusable" (default false),
+;;     "verification_key_or_identity"
+;;        (default "policy:q/release-evidence-v1"),
+;;     "compatibility_notes" (default ""),
+;;     "retention_policy_id" (default derived from --retention-days),
+;;     ...any other keys (e.g. digest-source annotations) are ignored. }
+;;
+;; Determinism: for byte-identical inputs the written bundle is byte-identical
+;; (canonical writer); `created_at` MUST therefore be supplied by the caller
+;; instead of being invented here. consume records carry the decision-time
+;; wall clock in `decided_at` only (the retained record is runtime evidence,
+;; not a canonical artifact).
+;;
+;; No network, no threads, no sleeps. Dependencies: racket/base plus the
+;; json, racket/contract, racket/file, racket/string and racket/date
+;; collections only (no new info.rkt deps).
+
+(require json
+         racket/contract
+         racket/date
+         racket/file
+         racket/string
+         (only-in "bundle-writer.rkt" finalize-proof-bundle write-proof-bundle!)

+;; scanner never mistakes an indented combinator for an external dependency
+;; (same discipline as bundle-writer.rkt).
+(define decision-contract (or/c 'reusable (list/c 'not-reusable symbol?) (list/c 'invalid symbol?)))
+
+(provide (contract-out
+          (write-command (-> (listof string?) integer?))
+          (consume-command (-> (listof string?) integer?))
+          ;; any/c on purpose: anything unanticipated must still fail closed
+          ;; (exit 4), which is exactly what the function guarantees.
+          (decision-exit-code (-> any/c integer?))
+          (normalize-request (-> hash? hash?))
+          (augmented-decision-record (-> (or/c string? hash?) hash? decision-contract hash?))

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; Exit-code contract (§11.3: no silent skip)
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+(define (decision-exit-code decision)
+  (cond
+    [(eq? decision 'reusable) 0]
+    [(and (pair? decision) (eq? (car decision) 'not-reusable)) 3]
+    [else 4]))

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+  (with-handlers ([exn:fail? (lambda (_) #f)])
+    (define m (and (string? s) (regexp-match rfc3339-z-rx s)))
+    (unless m
+      (error 'rfc3339-z->seconds "malformed RFC3339 UTC timestamp: ~s" s))
+    (define (n i)
+      (string->number (list-ref m i)))
+    (find-seconds (n 6) (n 5) (n 4) (n 3) (n 2) (n 1) #t)))

+  (define d (seconds->date s #f))
+  (format "~a-~a-~aT~a:~a:~aZ"
+          (pad2 (date-year d))
+          (pad2 (date-month d))
+          (pad2 (date-day d))
+          (pad2 (date-hour d))
+          (pad2 (date-minute d))
+          (pad2 (date-second d))))

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; Flag parsing (hand-rolled; deterministic, no cmdline exits)
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+      [(null? rest) #f]
+      [(string=? (car rest) flag)

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+;; normalize defensively (same discipline as bundle-validator.rkt).
+(define (json->symbols v)
+  (cond
+    [(hash? v)
+     (for/hash ([(k val) (in-hash v)])
+       (values (if (string? k)
+                   (string->symbol k)
+                   k)
+               (json->symbols val)))]
+    [(list? v) (map json->symbols v)]
+    [else v]))

+(define (read-json-file path what)
+  (with-handlers ([exn:fail? (lambda (_) #f)])
+    (json->symbols (call-with-input-file path read-json))))
+
+;; The decision vocabulary is symbol-valued ('reusable, 'not-reusable:<reason>,
+;; 'none); write-json accepts symbol KEYS but not symbol VALUES, so serialize
+;; symbols as strings (deep, deterministic).
+(define (json-safe v)
+  (cond
+    [(hash? v)
+     (for/hash ([(k val) (in-hash v)])
+       (values k (json-safe val)))]
+    [(list? v) (map json-safe v)]
+    [(symbol? v) (symbol->string v)]
+    [else v]))

+(define (write-json-file path record)
+  (define-values (base _name _dir?) (split-path path))
+  (when base
+    (make-directory* base))
+  (call-with-output-file path
+                         (lambda (out)
+                           (write-json (json-safe record) out)
+                           (newline out))
+                         #:exists 'replace))

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; Request normalization (JSON text -> the validator's request vocabulary)
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+;; The validator's in-memory request vocabulary (the one its own tests build
+;; with hasheq) is: symbol keys everywhere, EXCEPT the `expected-artifacts`
+;; map, whose keys are artifact names — DATA compared by `equal?` against the
+;; bundle's string-valued artifact names — plus symbol values for the two
+;; enum fields `subject-binding` and `claim-gate-class`. JSON has only
+;; strings, so the adapter translates exactly those positions. This is a
+;; faithful encoding of the validator's request contract, not a weakening:
+;; unknown enum strings stay unknown and fail closed inside the validator.
+(define (normalize-request request)
+  (define (as-symbol v)
+    (if (string? v)
+        (string->symbol v)
+        v))
+  (define (keys->strings h)
+    (for/hash ([(k v) (in-hash h)])
+      (values (if (symbol? k)
+                  (symbol->string k)
+                  k)
+              v)))
+  (define overrides
+    (hasheq 'subject-binding
+            (as-symbol (hash-ref request 'subject-binding #f))
+            'claim-gate-class
+            (as-symbol (hash-ref request 'claim-gate-class #f))
+            'expected-artifacts
+            (keys->strings (hash-ref request 'expected-artifacts (hasheq)))))
+  (for/hash ([(k v) (in-hash request)])
+    (values k (hash-ref overrides k v))))

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; q.reuse-decision/1 record assembly (validator step 15 + §11.3 fields)
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+;; bundle TEXT (or a parsed hash) for content addressing; the empty string
+;; (unreadable bundle) records bundle_id "unknown".

+  (define base (reuse-decision-record bundle request decision))
+  (define reusable? (eq? decision 'reusable))
+  (define reason (hash-ref base 'reason #f))
+  (hash-set
+   (hash-set
+    (hash-set (hash-set (hash-set (hash-set (hash-set (hash-set base
+                                                                'consumer-id
+                                                                (hash-ref request 'consumer-id #f))
+                                                      'source-sha
+                                                      (hash-ref request 'expected-commit-sha #f))
+                                            'affected-claim-set
+                                            (hash-ref request 'required-claim-ids '()))
+                                  'zero-tests-run
+                                  reusable?)
+                        'normal-proof-executed
+                        (not reusable?))
+              'fallback-cause
+              (cond
+                [reusable? 'none]
+                [reason reason]
+                [else 'consume-not-run]))
+    'request-current-time
+    (hash-ref request 'current-time #f))
+   'decided-at
+   (seconds->rfc3339-z (current-seconds))))

+;; `write` subcommand

+(define (required-doc-key doc key what)
+  (define v (hash-ref doc key #f))

+(define (section-or-error doc key)

+           (section-or-error doc 'command)
+           'environment
+           (section-or-error doc 'environment)
+           'policy
+           (section-or-error doc 'policy)
+           'prepared_environment
+           (section-or-error doc 'prepared_environment)

+           (section-or-error doc 'result)

+                   producer-identity

+                   workflow-revision-sha

+                   #t

+                   "evidence-store"

+                   created-at)

+(define (write-command args)

+  (define producer-identity (flag-lookup args "--producer-identity"))

+         (assemble-bundle-spec doc
+                               #:producer-identity producer-identity
+                               #:workflow-revision-sha workflow-revision-sha
+                               #:commit-sha commit-sha
+                               #:tree-sha tree-sha
+                               #:repository repository
+                               #:retention-days retention-days))

+       (displayln (hash-ref finalized 'bundle_id))

+
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; `consume` subcommand
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+

+  (define bundle (flag-lookup args "--bundle"))
+  (define request-path (flag-lookup args "--request-json"))
+  (define out (flag-lookup args "--out"))
+  (cond
+    [(not (and bundle request-path out))
+     (usage-error "consume" "requires --bundle F --request-json F --out F")]
+    [else
+     (define raw-request (read-json-file request-path "consumer request"))
+     (unless (hash? raw-request)
+       ;; An unreadable consumer request can never authorize a skip: record a
+       ;; fail-closed invalid decision and exit 4.
+       (define record
+         (augmented-decision-record "" (hasheq) (list 'invalid 'invalid:unreadable-consumer-request)))
+       (write-json-file out record)
+       (printf "consume: decision=invalid reason=invalid:unreadable-consumer-request exit=4~n"))
+     (if (hash? raw-request)

+  (define-values (decision bundle-text)

+          (file->string bundle)))
+      (values (with-handlers ([exn:fail? (lambda (_) (list 'invalid 'invalid:unreadable-bundle))])
+                (validate-proof-bundle-file bundle request))
+              text)))
+  (define record (augmented-decision-record bundle-text request decision))
+  (write-json-file out record)
+  (define code (decision-exit-code decision))
+  (printf "consume: decision=~a reason=~a exit=~a~n"
+          (if (pair? decision)
+              (car decision)
+              decision)
+          (if (pair? decision)
+              (cadr decision)
+              "none")
+          code)
+  code)

+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; CLI dispatch (direct invocation only; module top level stays pure so
+;; `raco test` and dynamic-require have no side effects)
+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+   "                      --commit-sha S --tree-sha S --repository S --out F [--retention-days N]")
+  (displayln "       consume.rkt consume --bundle F --request-json F --out F")
+  (displayln "exit codes (consume): 0 reusable, 3 not-reusable, 4 invalid"))

+  (define argv (vector->list (current-command-line-arguments)))
+  (cond
+    [(null? argv)
+     (usage)
+     (exit 2)]

+    [(string=? (car argv) "consume") (exit (consume-command (cdr argv)))]
+    [else
+     (usage)
+     (exit 2)]))

+(define rfc3339-rx #px"^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$")

+;; Flips one byte inside the FIRST artifact digest of the bundle file —
+;; corruption of an artifact body claim, not of the structural frame.
+(define (tampered-bundle-file!)
+  (define src (file->string bundle-file))
+  (define m1 (regexp-match-positions #rx"\"artifacts\"" src))
+  (unless m1
+    (error 'tamper "no artifacts section"))
+  (define from (cdr (car m1)))
+  (define m2 (regexp-match-positions #px"[0-9a-f]" src from))
+  (unless m2
+    (error 'tamper "no digest hex after artifacts"))
+  (define i (car (car m2)))
+  (define ch (string-ref src i))
+  (define replacement (if (char=? ch #\0) "1" "0"))
+  (define out (make-temporary-file "q-w9-tampered-~a.json" #f (ensure-bundle!)))
+  (call-with-output-file
+   out
+   (lambda (o) (display (string-append (substring src 0 i) replacement (substring src (add1 i))) o))
+   #:exists 'replace)
+  out)

+;; Extracts a top-level (2-space indented) job section from workflow text.
+(define (job-section text job-name)
+  (define lines (string-split text "\n"))
+  (define header (string-append "  " job-name ":"))
+  (define start (index-of lines header))
+  (and start
+       (let loop ([rest (list-tail lines (add1 start))]
+                  [acc '()])
+         (cond
+           [(null? rest) (string-join (reverse acc) "\n")]
+           [(regexp-match? #rx"^  [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*:\\s*$" (car rest))
+            (string-join (reverse acc) "\n")]
+           [else (loop (cdr rest) (cons (car rest) acc))]))))
+
+;; The step's own lines: from its "- name:" line up to (excluding) the next
+;; step. Used to prove a suite step carries no `if:` gating.
+(define (step-lines section step-name)
+  (define lines (string-split section "\n"))
+  (define start
+    (for/first ([l (in-list lines)]
+                [i (in-naturals)]
+                #:when (string-prefix? l (string-append "      - name: " step-name)))
+      i))
+  (and start
+       (let loop ([rest (list-tail lines start)])
+         (cond
+           [(null? (cdr rest)) (list (car rest))]
+           [(string-prefix? (cadr rest) "      - name:") (list (car rest))]
+           [else (cons (car rest) (loop (cdr rest)))]))))
+
+(define (unconditional-step? section step-name)
+  (define ls (step-lines section step-name))
+  (and ls
+       (not (for/or ([l (in-list ls)])
+              (string-prefix? (string-trim l) "if:")))))
+
+;; 0-based index of the first line containing NEEDLE (#f when absent).
+(define (index-of-line text needle)
+  (for/first ([l (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
+              [i (in-naturals)]
+              #:when (string-contains? l needle))
+    i))
